answered.sql: SELECT T2.fullname, T2.id FROM Movie AS T1 LEFT JOIN Actor AS T2 ON T1.LeadActorId = T2.id LEFT JOIN Actress AS T3 ON T1.LeadActressId = T3.id WHERE T3.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Show the name and id of the lead actor who has appeared in the most films
candidates.sql: SELECT A.fullname, A.id FROM Actor A JOIN Movie M ON A.id = M.LeadActorId GROUP BY A.id ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Show the name and id of the actor who has appeared in the most films as the lead actor.

candidates.meaning: Show the name and id of the actor who has the highest number of lead roles, even if it's not the most films overall.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.fullname, A.id FROM Actor A JOIN Movie M ON A.id = M.LeadActorId GROUP BY A.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

candidates.meaning: Show the name and id of the actor who has the most lead roles, considering both lead actor and lead actress roles in the same film.
candidates.sql: SELECT A.fullname, A.id FROM Actor A JOIN (SELECT LeadActorId AS ActorId FROM Movie UNION ALL SELECT LeadActressId AS ActorId FROM Movie) AS Roles ON A.id = Roles.ActorId GROUP BY A.id ORDER BY COUNT(Roles.ActorId) DESC LIMIT 1
